notes: Independent read-only review found no blocking defect; importer validation precedes _mutate/object writes.

Initial full suite had 12 preexisting runtime-child failures, reproduced on origin/main. Separate repair merged in PR244 (83ed516). Rebased full suite passed 2889 tests with 140 unconfigured owner/cgroup/install fixture skips; four wheel builds preceded checks.
Workspace suite itself passed all 100 tests without skips. Full hosted CI gates remain separately recorded in the PR; no runtime qualification, release or deployment.
No claim about hostile concurrent bundle-directory mutation, arbitrary object-store recovery, or physical power-loss durability.
